requirements: R1: The frontend must automatically present the fallback login form when Moodle SSO fails or is unreachable.

slices.title: Implement frontend fallback UI flow on SSO errors
slices.jtbd: When implementing fallback UI flow for this epic, I want the frontend to catch SSO errors, so that the manual fallback login form is presented to the user
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a failure to login via Moodle SSO
When the error occurs
Then the frontend should automatically prompt for or show the fallback login form instead of just failing.
Given the fallback form is displayed
When automated UI tests execute
Then the display of the fallback form upon SSO failure must be verified.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: SSO fallback form display success rate
